summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 100% of Secured Transportation Services LLC via a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated May 22, 2026. Total consideration is up to $13.0M, comprising approximately $6.0M cash (subject to a $0.5M adjustment) plus $1.0M in restricted common stock at closing and $6.0M in stock paid over five annual installments (capped at 10,364,476 shares). The board recommended the deal; no advisors named. The acquisition closed immediately on signing. What to watch: post-closing working capital adjustment mechanics and potential dilution from earn-out shares.
